initialAcceptance.reason: The first run inherited personal DSH presets with different bytes and was intentionally stopped. A dedicated home was prepared with matching presets, and the complete acceptance was restarted from the beginning on the same unchanged commit. Personal configuration was not changed.

development.result: 133/137 passed; initial test fixtures tried bevels on half-lap members and passed unfiltered catalog metadata as parameters. Test fixtures corrected; existing half-lap restrictions retained.
31/32 passed; CI coverage guide initially omitted the newly added browser step. Added the matching documentation row.

Failed after 11 checks: the test selected only the first comparison image, which was the old revision. The committed new checkpoint and right-hand preview existed. The corrected selector checks all preview images; the full browser run then passed.

installer.result: The first candidate install used builder pnpm 9.15.0 and stopped with ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT. The documented installer pnpm 10.28.2 was provisioned locally; the same profile then installed successfully, followed by final-archive installation in a fresh home. No global package-manager configuration was changed.

sharedStoreProbe.reason: The first source probe used the shared pnpm store. It passed but was excluded; subsequent canonical route runs used separate empty stores.

functionalRouteProbes.reason: Initial fresh source and tarball probes passed. Final complete runs also compared actual installed component bytes, modes and source lock resolutions before profile cleanup.

documentationCountFirstAttempt.reason: First local documentation count inherited the personal DSH preset mismatch. It also revealed stale README snapshots. The aggregate shell returned zero after its later git diff check, so it is not treated as count-check success.

retainedAttempts.lateObserver: An external source-file observer ran after its profile had been cleaned up and asserted failure. No byte audit was claimed from that attempt; the complete audited source route supersedes it.

limits: Spacing is center-to-center and bounded to 52–92 mm.
Native reopening verifies seven closed solids, twelve crossings and 126 interior sample cells per checkpoint; this is not manufacturing qualification.
This release preserves old 1.0.0 source locks without adding the new spacing parameter to them.
Four native platform payloads are included and byte-verified; this record does not claim Windows execution.
